title: Length-prefixed frame codec
spec: Implement frame::encode and frame::Decoder as their doc comments say: a frame is a 4-byte big-endian payload length then the payload; payloads over MAX_FRAME are TooLarge, and the decoder refuses an oversize header as soon as the 4 header bytes are in, without waiting for the body. Replace the `_todo` field with whatever state you need. No new dependencies.
